story: Green Valley State Park is located in Union County, Iowa, in the United States, featuring Green Valley Lake and land around it. Dedicated as a state park on September 20, 1953, it has nearly 10 miles of hiking trails passing through wetlands, woodlands, and prairie remnants.
matters: The park protects a natural area near Green Valley Lake with flora and fauna including shrubs, wildflowers, muskrats, deer, beavers, and various birds. It is also situated near the Mormon Trail.
name: Green Valley State Park
